caseName: Jones ex rel. Jones v. Heckler
caseNameFull: Jones, a Minor Child, by his Mother and Next Friend, Jones v. Heckler, Secretary of Health and Human Services

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certio-rari granted, 459 U. S. 965.] Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Miss. Code Ann. §91-1-15 (Supp. 1982), as to the Jones petitioners, and in light of Adkins v. McEldowney,-W. Va.-, 280 S. E. 2d 231 (1981), as to the Simms petitioners.
